## 1. 共通データのセット

```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# libraries needed
library(tidyverse)  # most variable creation here uses tidyverse 
library(tidyselect) # used to select variables in FP_EVENTS.R
library(haven)      # used for Haven labeled DHS variables
library(labelled)   # used for Haven labeled variable creation
library(expss)      # for creating tables with Haven labeled data
library(rJava)      # required for xlsx package
library(naniar)     # to use replace_with_na function
library(here)       # to get R project path
library(fs)         # for file path manipulation
library(openxlsx) 　# for exporting to excel
library(survey)       # for survey design


# 各種の関数セット読み込み
source("../myTools.R")  # プロジェクトルートから読み込む（quarto限定の処理）

# 対象とする年のリスト
# yearlist <- c("2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011",
# "2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")
yearlist <- c("2015")

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# データベース一覧

endes_list <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","endes_data_list.rds"))

# 変数ラベル一覧

endes_var_labels <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_var_labels.rds"))

```

## 2. データ処理

```{r}
# 必要なデータセットの抽出

# ソースコードのルートフォルダを指定
chap <- "Chap02_PH"

goAnalysis <- function(year){
  
  # 母親の雇用状態を追加
  keep_RECH1 <- c("hhid", "hv102", "hv105")
  keep_RECH0 <- c("hhid", "hv001", "hv002", "hv005", "hv022", "hv026",
                  "hv238", "hv241")
  keep_REC0111 <- c("caseid", "v001", "v002", "v161")
  keep_RE516171 <- c("caseid", "v502", "v743a", "v743b", "v743c", "v743d",
                     "v744a", "v744b", "v744c", "v744d", "v744e", "v633a",
                     "v633b", "v633c", "v633d", "v633e", "v633f", "v633g",
                     "v822", "v850a", "v850b")
  keep_RECH23 <- c("hhid", "hv270", "hv271","hv238", "hv244", "hv241", "v246a", "v246b",
                   "v246c", "v246d", "v246e", "v246f", "v246g", "v246h",
                   "hv246i", "hv246j", "hv246k", "hv219", "hv220")

  # 設定した年に基づいてファイルを読み込む
  df_RECH1 <- open_endes_file(year, "RECH1.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RECH1) %>% select(all_of(keep_RECH1))
  df_RECH0 <- open_endes_file(year, "RECH0.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RECH0) %>% select(all_of(keep_RECH0))
  df_REC0111 <- open_endes_file(year, "REC0111.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_REC0111) %>% select(all_of(keep_REC0111))
  df_RE516171 <- open_endes_file(year, "RE516171.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RE516171) %>% select(all_of(keep_RE516171))
  df_RECH23 <- open_endes_file(year, "RECH23.sav") %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>% # 変数名を小文字に変換
    add_missing_columns(keep_RECH23) %>% select(all_of(keep_RECH23))

  # number of children under 12 years old per household
  child_count <- df_RECH1 %>%
    filter(hv105 <= 12, hv102 == 1) %>%     # 年齢<=12かつde jureメンバー
    group_by(hhid) %>%              # クラスターIDと世帯IDで集計
    summarise(dm_children_under12 = n()) %>%   # 子供の数をカウント
    mutate(dm_children_under12 = ifelse(is.na(dm_children_under12), 0, dm_children_under12)) %>% # NAを0に置き換え
    ungroup()
    
  
  # 重複チェック
  duplicate_check(child_count, c("hhid"), "child_count")
  duplicate_check(df_RECH0, c("hhid"), "RECH0")
  duplicate_check(df_REC0111, c("caseid"), "REC0111")
  duplicate_check(df_RE516171, c("caseid"), "RE516171")
  duplicate_check(df_RECH23, c("hhid"), "REC23")
  
  print("データセットを結合します")
  HRdata <- child_count %>%
    left_join(df_RECH0, by = c("hhid" = "hhid")) %>%
    left_join(df_REC0111, by = c("hv001" = "v001", "hv002" = "v002")) %>%
    left_join(df_RE516171, by = c("caseid" = "caseid")) %>%
    left_join(df_RECH23, by = c("hhid" = "hhid")) %>%
    mutate(year = year)

  duplicate_check(HRdata, "hhid", "HRdata")
  print("データセットの結合が完了しました")
  print(paste("レコード数:", nrow(HRdata)))

  # type of cooking fuel per household  
  HRdata <- HRdata %>%
    group_by(hhid) %>% # クラスターIDと世帯IDで集計
    summarise(dm_cooking_fuel = first(v161)) %>% # 最初の調理燃料を取得
    mutate(dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = ifelse(dm_cooking_fuel < 7, 0, 1)) %>% # 伝統的な調理燃料かどうか  
    mutate(dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = ifelse(
      is.na(dm_cooking_fuel_traditional), 0, dm_cooking_fuel_traditional)
      ) %>% # NAを0に置き換え
    ungroup()
  
  # # 出力用のルートフォルダを指定
  # output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
  #   normalizePath() %>%
  #   trimws() # 正規化してトリムする
  # # 出力用のルートフォルダが存在しない場合は作成
  # if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
  #   dir_create(output_dir)
  # }
  # 
  # # WASHdata folderにrds形式で保存
  # print(sprintf("save WASHdata into output folder for %s", year))
  # print("WASHdata")
  # saveRDS(WASHdata, paste0(output_dir, "/WASHdata-ws.rds"))
  # print("complete WASHdata into output folder")
  
}

```

## 3. ループ実行

```{r}
#** ここから実行
for (yr in yearlist) {
  goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
